places.fn: The lodge says the building was put up in the 1950s as a sawmill serving the former mining town of Sawtooth City and later became a roadhouse restaurant; no restaurant opening year is given. The Ketchum address is the lodge's own mailing address; it sits on Highway 75 in the Sawtooth Valley, not in the city of Ketchum.
places.note: Roadhouse lodge on State Highway 75 whose year-round ice cream parlor serves a signature huckleberry flavor.
places.dish: huckleberry ice cream; milkshakes
places.seas: Ice cream parlor open year-round; restaurant keeps shoulder-season hours (Mon-Thu 9-5, weekends 9-7).

places.fn: The lodge's site carries a 'Since 1929' heading; no founding year for the restaurant at this building is given.
places.note: Log lodge restaurant on U.S. Highway 12 near Lolo Pass, on Mountain Time, whose 2026 breakfast menu lists huckleberry pancakes and French toast; Visit North Central Idaho (April 2026) lists trout and huckleberry desserts there. Its mailing address is Lolo, Montana 59847.
places.dish: huckleberry pancakes; huckleberry French toast; huckleberry desserts; trout; elk meatloaf; elk burger
places.seas: Summer hours posted; outdoor deck open about May through October, weather permitting.

places.fn: The resort's site links an '80th Anniversary' page but states no founding year on the home page.
places.note: Lakeside resort restaurant on Priest Lake whose dining page mentions locally picked huckleberries and whose April 2026 dinner menu lists a huckleberry rosemary compound butter and a cedar-roasted salmon with huckleberry.
places.dish: huckleberry rosemary compound butter; cedar roasted salmon with huckleberry
places.seas: All-season resort; winter getaway packages run early October to mid-May.

places.note: Breakfast and lunch restaurant in the historic Brooks Hotel in downtown Wallace, run by a mother-and-daughter team who are renovating the hotel; its menu lists a huckleberry pancake breakfast and a huckleberry-pecan cinnamon roll.
places.dish: Huckleberry Pancake Breakfast; Huckleberry-Pecan Cinnamon Roll
places.seas: Breakfast and lunch only: 7am-2pm fall to spring, 6am-2pm in summer.

places.fn: The resort says it 'has been a family tradition since 1932', and the Priest Lake Chamber listing says meals have been served in the historic lodge 'for over 90 years'; no exact opening year for the restaurant is sourced.
places.note: Dining room in the historic lodge at Elkins Resort on Priest Lake, which the Priest Lake Chamber of Commerce lists as the 'home of the huckleberry daquiris'.
places.dish: huckleberry daiquiri; tomahawk steak
places.seas: Open daily from about June through September and weekends the rest of the year; closed in November and from mid-March to mid-April.

places.note: Golf-course grill at the Coeur d'Alene Casino Resort's Circling Raven Golf Club on the Coeur d'Alene Reservation, whose menu lists a house salad with huckleberries, apples and Idaho honey dressing; the address given is the resort hotel's.
places.dish: Twisted Earth Salad with huckleberries
places.seas: Open during the Circling Raven Golf Club playing season; breakfast until 11am, lunch to 5pm; hours depend on business and weather.

places.note: Basque and Vietnamese counter inside The Warehouse Food Hall downtown.
places.dish: croquetas; solomo fries; banh mi

places.fn: An Idaho Statesman story (2018-05-30, reprinted by Euskal Kultura) says it opened in March 2018 in the Linen District building then addressed 1401 W Idaho St, with Dan Ansotegui cooking at night; Visit Boise (2026) lists the same corner as 175 N 14th St.
places.note: Pintxos and wine bar in the Linen District, a few blocks west of the Basque Block.
places.dish: pintxos; chorizo sandwich; charcuterie board

places.fn: Its locations page marked the Caldwell shop 'NOW OPEN' in 2025 (photos filed under 2025/09); no exact opening date is given.
places.note: Caldwell location of the Boise fry-and-burger shop, where fries are the main event and burgers come on the side.
places.dish: Idaho russet fries; homestyle fries; Idaho fry sauce; bison burger

places.fn: The sources read don't give its opening date; KIVI calls it a new addition to the local scene.
places.note: Counter-service taco shop from the Wylder Hospitality Group on East 34th Street in Garden City.
places.dish: al pastor tacos; barbacoa tacos; bean and cheese burrito
